# Daybreak

> Daybreak is a free daily Bitcoin brief built by Aron. It updates every morning before 08:30 Taipei time, reading 133 original and public indicators across on-chain data, price structure, derivatives, fund flows and macro sentiment to answer six questions: Where we are in the cycle; Which cost bases and levels price is standing on; Has the selling been worked through; Who is buying and where the money comes from; How crowded leverage and sentiment are; So what do I do. Every chart takes a side (bullish, bearish or neutral) and says why. Code computes every number; AI only explains them, it does not calculate or decide. Daybreak makes no trade calls.

Daybreak 是 Aron 做的免費比特幣每日判讀。每天台北時間早上 08:30 前更新，用 133 張自建與公開的指標，從鏈上、價格結構、衍生品、資金流、宏觀情緒拆開比特幣，回答六個問題：現在在週期的哪裡？價格站在哪些成本和關卡上？賣壓出清了沒？誰在買、錢從哪裡來？槓桿和情緒擠不擠？那我該怎麼做？每張圖都表態偏多、偏空或中性，並寫出理由。數字由程式計算，AI 只負責解釋，不計算也不做決定；不給交易建議。

Built and maintained by Aron (Aron Lab, https://aronlab.dev/). Bilingual: Traditional Chinese and English. Latest edition: Nov 20, 2026 close, No.46.

## Latest reading

Sellers are hurting more than at the June low and money is still leaving; loss-taking alone will not hold the prior low at 58.5K. — Short-term bearish: ETFs lost $632M on Nov 19 and stablecoins are down $17.9B in 30 days, so buyers are leaving while longs are only partly flushed. Long-term bullish: one-day realized losses relative to market cap are nearly double the June low's peak and unrealized profit is below the 2022 bottom, pain seen only in cycle-bottom zones. A close below 58,525 is a new cycle low, with the realized price at 53.3K next; a floor needs ETF or stablecoin flows to turn net positive.

- [完整最新判讀，中文（Markdown）](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/latest.md)

## Pages

- [Daybreak app](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/): the daily brief and all 133 charts, interactive (needs JavaScript); add ?lang=en or ?lang=zh
- [Cycle](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#cycle): Where we are in the cycle
- [Levels](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#lv): Which cost bases and levels price is standing on
- [Selling](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#sell): Has the selling been worked through
- [Demand](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#buy): Who is buying and where the money comes from
- [Leverage](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#lev): How crowded leverage and sentiment are
- [Exit](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/app/#exit): So what do I do
- [All charts](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/en/charts/): every chart on one page, grouped by the six questions, with today’s lean and reason; each chart also has its own page at /en/charts/<code>/ (中文：https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/charts/)
- [Daily briefs](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/en/brief/): one page per day since Oct 2026 (headline, overall lean, levels to watch, findings) at /en/brief/YYYY-MM-DD/ (中文：https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/brief/)
- [Case study](https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/case-study/en/): how Daybreak was designed and built, and how it checks its own calls (中文版：https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/case-study/)

## Method

- Data: free public sources (Bitview, CheckOnChain, CoinMetrics, Coinalyze, Binance, OKX, Deribit, Coinbase, Kraken, DefiLlama, FRED and others); each chart names its source and date.
- Code computes every number and every rule. AI writes the daily explanation from those numbers; it does not calculate and does not decide.
- Every chart is marked bullish, bearish or neutral with a one-line reason. The site makes no trade calls.
